'''Geska Prime''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Lifh sector/Legends|Lifh sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Yin Vocta]] could provide information about the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] activity on the planet.<ref name="WHoS&V" />
